# 2025 Delaware State Hornets football team

The 2025 Delaware State Hornets football team will represent Delaware State University as a member of the Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference (MEAC) during the 2025 NCAA Division I FCS football season. The Hornets are expected to be coached by first-year head coach DeSean Jackson and play at Alumni Stadium in Dover, Delaware.
